2116852519746076808.en_summary: Binance says $SOL withdrawals are re-enabled, along with $USDT and $USDC on Solana. Quote notes prior re-enables on Arbitrum ($ARB, $ETH, $USDT, $USDC) and Tron ($TRX, $USDT).

2116876411185373242.en_summary: Bloomberg projects the AI funding gap more than doubles to about $330B in FY27, with $ORCL and $SPCX the largest share. $GOOGL, $META, $AMZN and $MSFT gaps largely fade by FY28, while $CRWV, $NBIS and $IREN still need outside capital through FY30. Chart not inspected; figures from text.

2116877990386950314.en_summary: $AMZN AWS and company CEOs say an AI accelerator (GPU or Trainium) is being installed about every 14 seconds; capacity remains supply-constrained as customers absorb it quickly. Core compute and storage revenue grew at their fastest rates in several years.
2116877990386950314.zh_summary: $AMZN的AWS與公司執行長表示，約每14秒安裝一顆人工智慧加速器（GPU或Trainium）；產能仍受供應限制，客戶吸收速度很快。核心運算與儲存營收成長率達數年來最快。

2116878138139402307.en_summary: Mega-cap price action has been mixed: $AAPL and $MSFT are the only two in uptrends, while Alphabet $GOOG has fallen sharply. Chart not inspected; trend calls from text.
